name: How long does a kitchen remodeling project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen remodeling project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen remodeling project depends on its complexity. A basic cosmetic update involving painting, new fixtures, and appliance replacement might be completed in 3-4 weeks. A more extensive remodel that includes new cabinets, countertops, flooring, and minor layout changes typically takes 6-10 weeks from demolition to completion. Projects involving significant structural changes, custom cabinetry, or extensive plumbing and electrical work can extend to 10-16 weeks or longer. Unexpected issues, material delays, or changes during the project can also impact the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule before starting work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen remodels can take from 3-4 weeks for basic updates to 10-16 weeks for extensive projects, depending on complexity and scope.
